notes.title: Update Announcement for August 15, 2025:
notes.notes:
1.Added custom functionality for controller users, which can be viewed in settings after connecting a controller.

2.Performance optimization for the health display feature.

3.Introduced auto-aim functionality, selectable at the start of the game.

notes.title: Update on August 18, 2023:
notes.notes:
1. Add 3 new talismans:
   - 【Nine Dragon Golden Armor】: Equipping this armor provides impressive defense and immunity to toxins.
   - 【Meteor Starfall Ring】: Equipping this ring significantly enhances the attack power of the flying sword (summoned entity).
   - 【Phantom Bracelet】: Equipping this bracelet allows you to summon your own clone with the use of a phantom symbol to assist in combat.

2. Add 2 new items:
   - 【Phantom Symbol】: With the Phantom Bracelet equipped, you can use this symbol to summon your own clone, which lasts for one minute.
   - 【Hand Grenade】: A hand grenade that can be thrown by pressing the space key. Throwing distance: 5 units (Maximum carry limit: 5).

3. Various details have been optimized, but the specific improvements are not specified.

notes.title: August 16, 2023 Update:
notes.notes:
1. Added monster health bar, which can be displayed under the enemy's feet when attacking.
2. Enhanced Skill: Stealth, allows for instant kills on enemies without the need for backstabbing while in stealth.
3. Skill Reinforcement: Flash, now Flash will not be blocked by monsters, and it can be used even when surrounded.
4. Fixed a bug in the storyline.

notes.title: April 19, 2023 update announcement
notes.notes:
1. New induction mines, you can press F to place mines, up to three mines can exist at the same time in each map.
2. Fix the bug of pistol and rifle hit determination.
3. Optimize the game.

notes.title: Update announcement on December 26, 2021:
notes.notes:
1. Increase the display of the blood bar on the bottom of the character's feet
2. Increase the drop item reminder
3. Enhance some monster AI

notes.title: Update announcement on October 30, 2021:
notes.notes: The lighting effects have been optimized, and the surrounding scenes can now be seen.

notes.title: Update log on October 21, 2021
notes.notes:
1. Fix the bug that causes a black screen at a very low probability
2. New cheat system, you can enter codes in order to obtain important items in the game
Cheat code:

notes.title: Update on June 30, 2021
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug that could cause the player to get stuck
2. Optimized the logic of some monster spawning to save resources
